interface Direct<T> { value: T extends { value: infer U } ? U : never; }
interface Direct<T> { value: T extends { value: infer V } ? V : never; }

type Left<T> = T extends { value: infer U } ? U : never;
type Right<T> = T extends { value: infer U } ? U : never;
interface Aliased<T> { value: Left<T>; }
interface Aliased<T> { value: Right<T>; }

interface Callable {
  value: <T>(arg: T) => T extends { value: infer U } ? U : never;
}
interface Callable {
  value: <S>(arg: S) => S extends { value: infer U } ? U : never;
}

interface Shared {
  value: <T>(arg: T) => Left<T>;
}
interface Shared {
  value: <S>(arg: S) => Left<S>;
}
